twitch_goals.error.missing: Saved, but required elements are missing: %{elements}
twitch_goals.field.title: Title
twitch_goals.fill.follower: Bar of the follower goal – the width comes from current and target
twitch_goals.fill.sub: Bar of the sub goal – the width comes from current and target
twitch_goals.format_hint: data-format sets the notation: int for whole numbers with thousands separators, euro for amounts. Without it the value is inserted as is.
twitch_goals.is_default: Nothing custom is saved – the preset is shown. As soon as you save, your scaffold applies.
twitch_goals.missing_hint: These required elements are missing from the scaffold:
twitch_goals.name: Twitch goals
twitch_goals.never_checked: Never fetched. The background process gets the numbers by itself.
twitch_goals.no_goal: No goal of this kind exists on Twitch – only the counter is shown, without a target.
twitch_goals.no_script_hint: script, iframe and attributes like onclick are removed: this is about appearance. CSS belongs in the field below, not in a style element.
twitch_goals.perm.edit: may change the titles and appearance of the Twitch goals.
twitch_goals.required_hint: These attributes must appear in the HTML. If one is missing, the goal shows nothing in the overlay – and that only shows up mid-stream.
twitch_goals.reset_question: Really reset HTML and CSS to the preset?
twitch_goals.settings_lead: HTML and CSS of the scaffold in the overlay. The look of the old system is preset.
